messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync request — proposing Tue May 20 09:30 PT for a cross-team design sync covering the endpoint contract, SDK ergonomics, and Console UX for the new routing + streaming changes.

Alex Chen: High-level agenda: 1) API contract changes (5m) 2) SDK surface & migration (10m) 3) Console flow + mockups (10m) 4) Rollout plan & telemetry (10m) 5) Q/A and action items (15m).

Alex Chen: Pre-read (please review before the meeting):
- PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pulls/4123 (API + SDK draft)
- Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd-console-routing (Console mockups)
- Design doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/designs/routing-v2.md

Alex Chen: Can everyone confirm availability? I can send calendar invite once we lock time. @Maria Ortiz @Samir Patel for primary reviewers.

Maria Ortiz: I can do Tue 09:30 PT. Will focus on rollout/telemetry notes. :+1:

Samir Patel: Heads up — I have a conflict at 09:30, prefer 11:00 PT. If majority prefers 09:30 I can do async review and join for the last 20m.

Nina Park: 09:30 works for me. I'll take Console UX review and bring the mockups up to date before Mon EOD.

Leo Zhang: Tagged on the PR. Quick question about streaming semantics — are we keeping the same SSE framing or moving to chunked JSON? Example from PR: 

```
POST /v2/complete
{
  "model": "redwood-large-v2",
  "input": "...",
  "stream": true,
  "chunk_mode": "tokens"  // new optional field
}
```

Leo Zhang: If chunk_mode is optional we need clear server contracts and SDK helpers.

Alex Chen: Good call, Leo. In the pre-read I've noted the compatibility guarantees: default behavior unchanged; chunk_mode opt-in. SDKs should expose an adapter that maps old stream callbacks to the new chunk format.

Alex Chen: Pre-read checklist (what to actually check off before the meeting):
- [ ] Read PR and leave comments on API contract decisions (auth, error model, streaming framing)
- [ ] Verify SDK ergonomic examples for JS + Python (look for usage changes in README)
- [ ] Review Console mockups and note accessibility/placement concerns
- [ ] Add any required migration steps or compatibility tests to PR
- [ ] Ops: confirm telemetry events + rollout SLOs in the design doc

Samir Patel: Please add a short migration appendix to the design doc with example curl + SDK snippets. I'll add a compatibility test plan.

Maria Ortiz: UX acceptance criteria request: add a list of 3 measurable tasks (e.g., "new endpoint visible in Console settings", "stream preview shows first token within 300ms") — I'll write them into the Figma file.

DeployBot: Calendar invite created: Cross-team design sync — Tue May 20 09:30 PT — attendees: Alex Chen, Maria Ortiz, Nina Park, Leo Zhang, (Samir Patel: tentative). Link: https://calendar.internal/event/xyz

Alex Chen: If you can't make it, please leave comments on the PR and mark yourself as "can't attend" in the invite. Otherwise I'll send the final agenda and a reminder 24h before. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Action items before Mon EOD: reviewers to post any blocking concerns on the PR; Nina to update Figma; Samir to add compatibility tests draft.
